headline: South Africa's Ramaphosa Hopes for U.S. Relations Reset After Midterms
summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa hopes the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections could mark a turning point. Pretoria seeks to improve ties with Washington following previous diplomatic and economic setbacks.
why: Bilateral trade relations and diplomatic agreements such as AGOA are critical for emerging market export stability and foreign direct investment.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Political shifts in the US could impact bilateral economic and trade relations with South Africa.
